mapper.update: UPDATE eb_flower_delivery_slot SET booked_count = booked_count + 1, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{slotId} AND enabled = 1 AND cutoff_time > NOW() AND booked_count < capacity
UPDATE eb_flower_delivery_slot SET booked_count = booked_count - 1, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{slotId} AND booked_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eb_flower_delivery_slot WHERE delivery_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND enabled = 1 AND cutoff_time > NOW() AND booked_count < capacity ORDER BY delivery_date ASC, start_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE eb_flower_delivery_slot SET delivery_date = #{slot.deliveryDate}, start_time = #{slot.startTime}, end_time = #{slot.endTime}, capacity = #{slot.capacity}, cutoff_time = #{slot.cutoffTime}, enabled = #{slot.enabled}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{slot.id} AND booked_count <= #{slot.capacity}
